items.title: Strata runs a 125B MoE model on a 12GB consumer GPU
items.summary: Strata offloads Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's 24,576 experts across GPU, RAM, CPU, and SSD, activating only 10 per token, for 53-94 tok/s on a 12GB RTX 5070. Speculative decoding adds a 1.6-1.8x speedup, and the Coder variant hits 91% SWE-bench at 32GB. A 125B model now runs on one consumer GPU. (3 minute read)

items.title: LeCun dismisses AI extinction risk; Amodei calls him deluded
items.summary: Yann LeCun says he has zero concerns about AI wiping out humanity, including recent 'rogue agent' incidents, a stance Dario Amodei has called deluded. (2 minute read)

items.title: OpenMausBot runs Claude, Codex, and Grok as a local agent team
items.summary: OpenMausBot runs Claude, Codex, and Grok as separate agents behind one local harness, normalizing their CLIs into a single event stream on 127.0.0.1:8799. It stores all data in ~/.openmausbot instead of the cloud and has drawn 4,037 GitHub stars. Anyone can now swap or mix coding-agent backends from one chat app. (3 minute read)

items.title: Anthropic met with religious scholars on AI consciousness
items.summary: Anthropic met with religious scholars, including Vatican-linked figures, to discuss whether AI systems like Claude could be conscious. (2 minute read)

items.title: Anthropic asks users to opt in to sharing voice data
items.summary: Anthropic is now asking Claude users to voluntarily share their voice conversations to help train future models. (1 minute read)

items.title: SCM brings local semantic search to every Mac photo and video frame
items.summary: SCM indexes every photo and video frame on a Mac locally, using CLIP or SigLIP embeddings plus ffmpeg shot detection to land on the exact moment in a clip. Tesseract OCR and Whisper add text and speech search, and an optional local llama.cpp chat queries the results with citations. Nothing leaves the machine. (3 minute read)

items.title: Magpie lets any coding agent run on any model vendor
items.summary: Magpie runs a local gateway on 127.0.0.1:3425 that speaks the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, forwarding calls to whichever vendor serves the chosen model. It edits 50+ agents' config files in place and has reached 4,861 GitHub stars. One menu bar now switches models across every coding agent. (3 minute read)

items.title: Trump taps Jay Clayton to lead new Super Intelligence Force
items.summary: President Trump named former SEC chair Jay Clayton to lead a new Super Intelligence Force reporting directly to him and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (2 minute read)
